speaker: alice
text: First up, the humpback migration is winding down along the South East Queensland coast and what a season it's been. Whale watchers from the Gold Coast to Mooloolaba have been clocking record numbers of mums with calves cruising south back to Antarctica.

speaker: charlie
text: It's basically the world's slowest, most majestic school run. Those little calves have put on serious weight in our warm bay waters before the big swim south, so good on us for being a decent nursery.

speaker: alice
text: Meanwhile up on the Great Barrier Reef, scientists reckon the spring full moon is about to trigger mass coral spawning, where entire reefs release their eggs and sperm into the water all at once. It is one of the great natural spectacles on the planet and it happens right in our backyard.
